description:
Catalog of the AVIZ node types a scene is built from: generators (draw an image), filters (process one), mixers, modulators (output numbers), outputs.
Without ids: a short row per effect (id, name, category, description, inputs) plus the music sources, choice orders and triggers. Pick effects here first.
With ids: full specs for those effects — every parameter (type, min/max/step, options, default) and default_binds (the music bindings a fresh node gets). Ask for details only of the effects you will use; detail:true for everything is ~400 KB.
Examples: {"category":"generator","search":"tunnel"} · {"search":"glitch"} · {"ids":["kanjirain","bloom","output"]}

detail.description: Full specs for every listed effect (large).

ids.description: Effect ids to return with full parameter specs.

search.description: Words that must all appear in the id, name or description.

name: list_effects
title: List AVIZ effects
